newsitem.title: USA: Health Management files proxy for merger.
newsitem.headline: Health Management files proxy for merger.

text.p: Health Management Inc said Wednesday it filed definitive proxy materials with the Securities and Exchange Commission about a subsidiary of Transworld HealthCare Inc and Health Management.
A special meeting of shareholders was set for July 11.

Health Management said the consummation of the merger is subject to customary closing conditions, including the approval of Transworld's senior lenders. The waiting period under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvement Act has expired.

Health Management also said it and Transworld agreed to extend the cut-off date in the merger agreement to July 31 from June 30 and to extend the forbearance agreement relating to Health Management's bank debt to July 15.

Health Management also said that on June 9 the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of New York granted final approval of the "restated stipulation of partial settlement" in connection with a class action suit. The stipulation provides for the settlement of the class action lawsuit against Health Management for $4.55 million, of which $3.2 million was paid into escrow and $1.35 million will be paid at the time of the merger.

Health Management and certain executive officers and the former chief financial officer are defendants in another lawsuit filed in U.S. District Court. The company said it intends to defend itself vigorously.
